{{Quote|You are to face the champion."<br />"Let me pass."<br />"May the forest spirits grant you blessings.|Hwruarca and a Kerritamba Village Arena contestant|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
'''Hwruarca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] member of the [[Shoartu]] tribe of the [[Kerritamba Village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she and [[Rhylis]] worked as arena guards at the [[Kerritamba Village Arena]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You have not been deemed worthy enough to enter the Arena.|Hwruarca, to an unworthy passerby|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] by the name of Hwruarca lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] among her fellow Wookiees in the [[Shoartu]] tribe of the [[Kerritamba Village]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="ROTW" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> she and a fellow male Wookiee by the name of [[Rhylis]] had been assigned the role of arena guards, tasked with the responsibility of guarding the [[Kerritamba Village Arena]]. Hwruarca guarded the entrance to the arena, while Rhylis guarded the exit.<ref name="ROTW" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees}}
Hwruarca allowed at least one contestant to enter the arena, in order to face [[Shoartu Arena Champion]] [[Wirartu]] in combat.<ref name="ROTW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
During her time as an arena guard, Hwruarca wore a brown and gray [[Color/Legends|colored]] Wookiee [[Clothing/Legends|battle padding]].<ref name="ROTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hwruarca was a non-player character in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'', a [[2005]] [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]]<ref name="ROTW" /> to [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hwruarca was featured in a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] titled "[[W:c:swg:Arena Challenge: Face Wirartu|Arena Challenge: Face Wirartu]]," in which players were tasked with defeating Wirartu in [[W:c:swg:Combat|combat]]. In order to do so, players had to speak with Hwruarca to enter the arena.<ref name="ROTW" /> In the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|game's]] directory tree files and source data, Hwruarca's name is listed as '''Hwroarca''' (an Arena Guardian).<ref name="TRE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' directory tree files and source data</ref> However, this alternative name was not used in the game, and is therefore considered [[Canon|non-canon]] in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]].<ref name="ROTW" />
